# No sound from one track

also: a single track is silent

## Another track is soloed
check: a Solo button is lit anywhere in the mixer
fix: ableton/live-12 §18.6

## The Track Activator is off
check: the track's number in the mixer is unlit
fix: ableton/live-12 §18.1
